files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Customer logos together with the key numbers: logos above the numbers, or beside them. Axes: layout (above,
  beside), logos (name, icon), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Logo } from "./logo-cloud.types";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";

  export type ProofBandProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    logos: Logo[];
    empty?: string;
    stats: Stat[];
    layout?: "above" | "beside";
    logoStyle?: "name" | "icon";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    logos,
    empty = "",
    stats,
    layout = "above",
    logoStyle = "name",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: ProofBandProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} align="center" landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((logos?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="building-2" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "beside") ? "1-2" : "1")} class="items-center gap-8">
      <Group gap="6" justify="center" class="flex-wrap text-muted-foreground" data-testid="logos">
        {#each logos as logo (logo.id)}
          <Group gap="2" align="center" data-testid="logo">
            <LucideIcon name={logo.icon} size={24} />
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" class={(((logoStyle as string) === "icon") ? "sr-only" : "")}>
              {logo.name}
            </Text>
          </Group>
        {/each}
      </Group>
      <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "beside") ? "2" : "1-4")} class="gap-6 text-center" data-testid="stats">
        {#each stats as stat (stat.id)}
          <Stack gap="0" align="center" data-testid="stat">
            <Text size="4xl" weight="bold">
              {stat.value}
            </Text>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {stat.label}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        {/each}
      </Grid>
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
